Name: CP ahri1014's Smaller Statue Obelisks
Author: ahri1014
Description:
[font=Georgia][size=3]!!! Please read before installing! !!!
[/size][/font][font=Georgia]All five (farm obelisk is included!) base game obelisks have seasonal replacements, all of which can be individually turned on or off in the config. [/font][b]ALL [/b][font=Georgia]obelisk replacements turn off the "draw shadows" function, meaning the game will not automatically draw shadows underneath the obelisk. If you have these enabled and use another texture or skin, it will still remove the shadow.[/font]

[font=Georgia]In addition, there are config settings to turn off the shadows on the two add-on obelisks, [/font][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5787]East Scarp[/url][font=Georgia] and [/font][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9600]Visit Mount Vapius[/url][font=Georgia]. Both add-on obelisks can be accessed from Robin at the Carpenter's Shop or from the book in the Wizard's tower as skins, or if you've already placed the obelisks, by painting the buildings.[/font]

[font=Georgia]All obelisks are seasonal, except for the Farm Obelisk, which has a tropical theme year-round.[/font]

[font=Georgia]Big thanks to [/font][url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/lemurkat?gameId=1303]Lemurkat[/url][font=Georgia] and[/font][url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Lumisteria?gameId=1303] Lumisteria[/url][font=Georgia] for letting me use their assets for obelisk skins!﻿ [/font][font=Arial]<3[/font]
